context: Sho asks his mother about death after a pet bird passed away. Yumiko explains as honestly as she can to a six-year-old.
purpose: mother carefully explaining death to small child — quiet careful honesty

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お母さん…ピーちゃん、死んじゃった。
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old soft small wet-voice grief-disclosure, the small real raw-distress audible, soft small warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: …うん。お母さんも、すごく悲しい。
lines.style: Maternal warm soft tender deep-matching-grief warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old soft small vulnerable existential-asking, the small real raw-question audible, soft small warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 生きてるものは、みんな、いつか、お別れがあるの。
lines.en: Living things — everyone, someday, has a farewell.
lines.style: Maternal warm soft tender careful honest-explaining-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃんも？お父さんも？
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old soft small vulnerable widening-fear-asking, the small real raw-anxiety audible, soft small warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: …うん。でも、まだまだ、ずっと先のこと。
lines.en: …Yes. But still, much later in time.
lines.style: Maternal warm soft tender careful honest-then-reassuring-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ピーちゃん、どこ行くの？
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old soft small vulnerable wondering-asking, the small real raw-curiosity audible, soft small warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お空にね、お星様になって、ずっと見守ってくれる。
lines.en: Into the sky, becomes a star, watches over forever.
lines.style: Maternal warm soft tender gentle imaginative-comforting-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old soft small careful wanting-to-believe-fragile, the small real fragile-hope audible, soft small warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。だから、お空見たら、いつでもピーちゃん思い出せる。
lines.en: Yes. So, when you look at the sky, you can always remember Pii-chan.
lines.style: Maternal warm soft tender gentle deep-comforting-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: …ピーちゃん、寂しくないかな。
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old soft small tender worried-caring-disclosure, the small real raw-care audible, soft small warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 寂しくないよ。しょうくんが思い出す度、ピーちゃん、笑ってる。
lines.en: Not lonely. Each time you remember, Pii-chan smiles.
lines.style: Maternal warm soft tender deep gentle-reassuring-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old soft small sincere tender-committed-warm closing, the small real warmth audible, soft small warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お母さんも、一緒に思い出すね。
lines.style: Maternal warm soft tender deep gentle-extending-warm closing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.
